characterizations.result_summary: Inherent viscosities of 6 polycarbonate samples were measured, values range from 0.18 to 0.77 dL/g.

evidence.source_sentence: The inherent viscosities,  $\eta_{inh}$, were measured with an Ubbelohde viscometer at a concentration 0.5 dL/g.

characterizations.result_summary: X-ray diffraction measurements were performed on 6 polycarbonate samples, all found to be semicrystalline, with degree of crystallinity ranging from 25.4% to 40.3%.

evidence.source_sentence: The x-ray diffraction diagram was recorded with a powder method with an x-ray diffractometer (Philips model PW 1710).

characterizations.result_summary: Glass transition temperatures of 6 polycarbonate samples were measured, values range from 141 to 206°C.

evidence.source_sentence: thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), contact angle, and limiting oxygen index (LOI).

characterizations.result_summary: FTIR spectra were recorded for 6 polycarbonate samples, characteristic absorption peaks of functional groups were detected.

evidence.source_sentence: Infrared (IR) spectra in the range 4000–400 cm  $^{-1}$ of the synthesized monomers and polymers in solid state were obtained for samples in KBr disks (JASCO IR-700 spectrometer).

characterizations.result_summary: Thermogravimetric analysis was performed on 6 polycarbonate samples, thermal degradation temperatures and residual mass at 600°C were measured.

evidence.source_sentence: thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), contact angle, and limiting oxygen index (LOI).
The thermal behavior of polymers was evaluated by means of TGA and DSC.
